game_title: Code Reading Relay – Merchant Waystation Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Waystation, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round, giant scorpions strike the sundial, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predicted value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the sundial from giant scorpions in Merchant Waystation: keep the predicted meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: predicted drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
